hazards.control: Eye and skin protection at the cementing unit; dust controls at bulk transfer.

name: Cement sheath
function: The set cement in the annulus between each casing string and the hole or the previous casing, supporting the string and isolating the formations behind it.

tabs.overview: Slurry per API 10A class and additives; placed by displacement with plugs; top of cement set by the design and confirmed by a bond log or a temperature survey. Channels or a poor bond let frac stages communicate behind pipe.
tabs.engineering: API 10A cements; density and thickening time per the well.
tabs.evidence: API Spec 5CT (S27), API Spec 10A (S28), API RP 10D-2 (S30), field practice (S9). Sizes are public nominal values; the schematic depth is not to scale.
